mapper.sql: id, course_id AS courseId, name, event_date AS eventDate, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, location, description, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM course_event WHERE course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY event_date, start_time

SELECT e.course_id AS courseId, c.course_code AS courseCode, 'CourseEvent' AS type, e.name AS title, e.event_date AS `date`, e.start_time AS startTime, e.end_time AS endTime, e.location, 'Event' AS source, e.id AS sourceId FROM course_event e INNER JOIN enrollment en ON en.course_id = e.course_id AND en.user_id = #{userId} AND en.active = 1 INNER JOIN course c ON c.id = e.course_id WHERE e.event_date >= #{fromDate} AND e.event_date <= #{toDate} ORDER BY e.event_date ASC, e.start_time ASC, e.id ASC
